terra.problem: The drawer joke does not make clear what Papa Dorin would be waiting for, so the comparison does not click.
It states as fact that Bildad feels looked down on. The text gives his question, not his feeling.
Bildad speaks for the group using ‘we,’ but the passage does not say the other friends also say this.
The passage says the lamp goes out, but does not establish that it is not taken.
Saying Papa Dorin hid in a dark drawer suggests he went there to hide. In his backstory, he was placed in the junk drawer.
The map and passport joke makes light of the man being torn from shelter and marched off to the king of terrors.
The passage calls him the king of terrors; it does not say he is named for what he brings.
Dry roots do not necessarily mean a plant has nothing holding it up or feeding it. The passage does not make that claim.
The passage names the roots and branches. Saying the picture covers every part of the tree stretches it beyond those details.
‘Nobody is left behind’ drops the passage’s qualifications: no offspring or posterity among his people and no survivor where he once lived.
The passage does not say that Job hears every word.
The explanation is flat and generic, repeating the answer without Papa Dorin’s warmth or personality.
